evidence: Signature belongs to the product's mechanism: the pick-up calendar marks library sessions with an 'Open' tag (green dot at 375) on Wednesdays and Saturdays only (tool/default/1280-light, 375-light).

Copy is bound to this library: 'deposit £20, returned when the tool comes back', 'Wednesday 28 October, 18:00 to 20:00', '14 Mill Lane', 'call the desk on 01632 960552', volunteer-style tool names ('Jigsaw, corded, with 8 blades').

Swap test fails for the visual frame: a click-and-collect pharmacy or council equipment loan could reuse the white bordered cards, the muted green accent, the one sans and the identical wrench thumbnail unchanged; only words change.

Category-guess fails: 'community/eco organisation' default predicts pale green-grey ground, white bordered cards, one rounded humanist sans, a generic icon per item - which is what the find page shows.
Similar-prompt fails for the first viewport: 'reservation page for a neighbourhood seed library' would land on the same heading + intro + search bar + 2-column card grid with placeholder icons.

evidence: First viewport at 1280 (find): heading 'Find a tool', grey paragraph, a full-width empty search field, then rows of identical white cards with identical wrench squares; nothing rewards a look beyond tidy order.
After one scroll: 'Opening times' paragraph and a one-line footer; no imagery of tools, the room or the desk.
